description: Route choice on the live Delhi road graph: Dijkstra (shortest), QAOA choice (classically simulated statevector QAOA over the same Yen candidates), exhaustive best over those candidates, and the straight line as a reference only. Trips are synthetic.

settings.blockage_rule: road blocked when flood_exposure >= 0.85 - blockage (same as the engine)
settings.hazard_metric: sum over edges of flood_exposure * edge length (km)
